## Homework

1.  Create any dataset you’d like
2.  Write two useful functions:

- One that creates a plot
- One that does something else

3.  Create a Quarto document showing:

- At least 2 examples per function
- Evidence of the function’s flexibility

4.  Due: Tuesday at 1 PM

## Load Libraries

```{r}
library(tidytuesdayR)
library(PNWColors)
library(ggplot2)
```

## Load Data

```{r}
nde_experiences <- readr::read_csv('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday/main/data/2026/2026-07-21/nde_experiences.csv')
```

## Create Functions

### Function 1: Valid Near Death Experience's

#### Greyson Scores that are above the value 7, are considered valid near death experiences

```{r}
valid_nde <- function(greyson_score){
  validity<- if (greyson_score>7){
        validity <- "yes"
  } else {
    validity <- "no"
  }
  return(validity)
  }
  
```

#### Example 1

```{r}
valid_nde(10)
```

This experience was valid.

#### Example 2

```{r}
valid_nde(4)
```

This experience was not valid

### Function 2: Boxplot

```{r}
nde_plot <- function(data, x, y, fill) {
  pal <- pnw_palette("Sailboat", 2, type = "discrete")
  
 ggplot(data, aes(x = {{x}}, y = {{y}}, fill = {{fill}})) +
    geom_boxplot() +
    scale_fill_manual(values = pal) +
    theme_bw()
}
```

#### Example 1

```{r}
nde_plot(nde_experiences, x=gender, y=greyson_score, fill=ai_aliens)+
  labs(x="Gender",y="Greyson Score", fill="AI Aliens")

```

#### Example 2

```{r}
nde_plot(nde_experiences, x=ai_clinical, y=greyson_score, fill=gender)+
  labs(x="AI Clinical", y="Greyson Score", fill="Gender")

```
